name: ProgressBar
purpose: Thin determinate bar showing the done ratio of a list or pane, with no text inside. Any percentage label is rendered by the consumer beside it (for example the draft-inspector '25 %' label is not part of the widget).

values.when: Fill uses the done-lamp colour token. The reference fills blue; both designs change this because accent blue is reserved for primary action and selection. Track uses the muted token. See open.

props.name: value
props.description: Done ratio between 0 and max. Catalogue values: 0 (task-list empty), 0.25 (main-window, task-list, draft-inspector, filter-panel, trash) and 0.3333 (main-window split pane).

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound. Default 1, so value is a ratio.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required, because the bar has no text. Examples: 'Done in Inbox', 'Done in this pane'.

props.name: tone
props.description: Fill colour token. Only done is defined.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout escape hatch. Width is fixed at 84px (6rem on the 14px root) and track height about 4px (0.286rem) as fixed defaults; not set per consumer.

states: empty (value 0; track only, as on the task-list empty row)
partial (0 < value < max; fill shows the ratio)
full (value equals max; fill to 100% with the done-lamp colour; B calls this complete and derives it; not recorded in the catalogue)
role: progressbar (from Radix Progress), with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin 0 and aria-valuemax
keyboard: None. Not focusable. Read-only, no actions.
open: Sources: A and B. (1) Fill colour: the reference is blue (colour not measured); both designs use the done-lamp colour instead. Confirm against the source before the screens are built. (2) Full state: look not recorded; fill to 100% assumed. Decide whether a distinct complete look is needed. (3) Track height is measured on two rows and estimated on three. (4) Component name is '?' on filter-panel and trash. (5) B's single size default (84px width) is folded into the fixed defaults; it is not a catalogue variant.
